integrity: Symbolic normalization and direct-coordinate cross-checks are reproducible with an embedded standalone script. Finite numerical diagnostics are illustrative, not an existence proof.
scientific_limitations: Local small-invariant-circle theorem in a specified nonnegative cyclic competition region; no global attraction, complete resonance classification beyond order four, or physical positive-octant invariance outside the local neighborhood. Historical priority not independently established; full text of the 1987 same-map predecessor was unavailable.
title: A universal supercriticality law for the first oscillatory instability of cyclic Euler–Lotka–Volterra competition
